responsibilities: Designing, developing, optimizing, and maintaining the data architecture and ELT/ETL pipelines that support our business goals across charging sessions, billing, invoicing, and promotions.
Build and maintain large-scale batch and streaming pipelines, data warehouse models, and transformation layers that are reliable, performant, and well documented.
Own the semantic layer that turns physical tables into governed business metrics, so that every team consumes one consistent definition of revenue, margin, usage, and active customers.
Prepare and structure data so it is AI ready, enabling natural-language analytics, retrieval, and AI-assisted experiences on top of a trusted foundation.

Become a master of the business domain, not only the data. Understand how charging, billing, settlement, invoicing, and OEM and fleet economics actually work, and let that knowledge drive how you model and expose the data.
Manage integrations between Snowflake, Power BI, SAP, APIs, and other analytics tools so the platform serves both reporting and operational needs.
Partner directly with analysts, data scientists, finance, and product to understand requirements, translate them into robust data solutions, and communicate the trade-offs back to stakeholders.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously optimize infrastructure performance and cost.
